naming_conventions.rule: React components must use PascalCase for filenames and exports.

naming_conventions.evidence: users table (is_active, email_verified_at) mapped in User.php

folder_conventions.rule: Shared, generic UI elements must be placed in resources/js/Components/UI.
folder_conventions.evidence: Button.jsx, Card.jsx, Pagination.jsx exist in this folder and are imported globally.

folder_conventions.rule: React Pages must be grouped by Domain and Module under resources/js/Pages/Dashboard/.

import_conventions.rule: Frontend imports must use the @/ alias to resolve to resources/js/.
import_conventions.evidence: import Button from '@/Components/UI/Button' seen across multiple pages.

service_conventions.rule: Complex business logic, especially involving the filesystem or external APIs, must be extracted into stateless Service classes in app/Services.
service_conventions.evidence: app/Services/ImageService.php encapsulates intervention/image and Storage::disk logic.

service_conventions.rule: Services must not dictate HTTP responses (e.g., no Inertia::render inside Services).
service_conventions.evidence: ImageService returns strings (paths), not Response objects.

component_conventions.rule: Raw HTML tags (like <button> or <table>) must not be used directly for primary UI elements; use the abstraction from UI/.
component_conventions.evidence: Absence of raw <button> in Users/Index.jsx; relies heavily on <Button> and <Table> from Components/UI.

component_conventions.rule: Destructive actions must be protected by ConfirmModal.
component_conventions.evidence: Users/Index.jsx utilizes ConfirmModal for delete actions.

layout_conventions.rule: All Dashboard pages must be wrapped in the DashboardLayout component.
layout_conventions.evidence: resources/js/Pages/Dashboard/Admin/Users/Index.jsx and Settings.jsx both use <DashboardLayout> as the root wrapper.

layout_conventions.rule: Page content forms and tables must be enclosed within a Card component.
layout_conventions.evidence: Settings.jsx wraps its form fields in <Card>.

routing_conventions.rule: Routes must be modularized into domain-specific files rather than bloating web.php.
routing_conventions.evidence: routes/web.php iterates over glob(routes/Admin/*.php) to load routes dynamically.

validation_conventions.rule: Validation must be performed imperatively inside the controller action using $request->validate(), not via external FormRequest classes.

permission_conventions.rule: Authorization checks must be bound using Spatie middleware in the Controller's constructor.
